signed_rows.behavior: an event for a PNG that is not valid UTF-8 sends temp_upload, then add resource with to = D/name and source_name = name, and ends with the PNG's exact bytes at D/name/name and sibling files untouched
signed_rows.fails_when: the fake OpenViking receives content/write for it, the calls or their fields differ, the stored bytes differ, or a sibling changes

signed_rows.behavior: a changed PNG replaces the one at D/name/name, and a plain file left at D/name by the old text write is deleted before the upload
signed_rows.fails_when: D/name/name holds the old bytes, a second copy appears, or a file remains at D/name

signed_rows.behavior: a non-UTF-8 object that is not one of the image types is skipped with an INFO 'binary file skipped' line naming the key, and nothing is written
signed_rows.fails_when: OpenViking receives any write or upload for it, or no such INFO line appears

signed_rows.behavior: a valid UTF-8 object with multi-byte characters still goes through content/write byte for byte, even with an image extension
signed_rows.fails_when: it is uploaded as a resource, or the stored content differs from the object's bytes

signed_rows.behavior: catch-up counts D/name/name as the image's copy, uploads a missing image, and removes D/name/name and the emptied D/name folder when the bucket no longer holds the image
signed_rows.fails_when: catch-up re-uploads an image that is present, misses a missing one, or leaves the image or its folder behind after the object is gone

signed_rows.behavior: the module tests and vet pass, and the repo gates pass
signed_rows.fails_when: just -f applications/ov-sync-consumer/justfile test or just pre_commit exits non-zero

signed_rows.behavior: after the operator releases v0.1.1 and applies, the three PNGs in docs/reference/architecture/ open in ov-dash at D/name/name and download with the same bytes as git, and no damaged plain copy remains at D/name
signed_rows.fails_when: ov-dash reports a PNG as damaged, a download differs from git, or a plain file remains at D/name
